name: OmaiPhone
author: Dankestrick
description: Your iPhone on Omarchy over Bluetooth: take and make calls with the PC's microphone and speakers, read and send texts, see the iPhone's notifications, control its music and check its battery. No app on the phone, no cloud.

dependencies.name: PyGObject
dependencies.why: Calls, contacts, notifications and music talk to PipeWire and BlueZ over D-Bus

dependencies.name: dbus-next
dependencies.why: Texts talk to BlueZ's OBEX service over D-Bus

dependencies.name: obexd
dependencies.why: Carries texts (MAP) and the phone book (PBAP)

dependencies.name: pw-play
dependencies.why: Rings on the PC; its WebRTC filter removes noise and echo during calls

dependencies.name: pactl
dependencies.why: Finds and mutes the call's audio streams

dependencies.name: setpriv
dependencies.why: Ends the background programs together with the shell

barWidget.description: Calls, texts, notifications, music and battery of your iPhone.
